title: ButtonFix
description: Fixing the ugly buttons from version 26.2
body:
## 🔥 The mod moves the buttons from the middle of the menu to more suitable places
![Before-After](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afea3baf89e66ac03a449261aea463904fa448a4_0.webp)

The mod modifies the **🎮Main Menu** and the **⏸Pause Menu**
